question: Who is best known for his testimony on climate change to congressional committees in the 1980 s, Which helped raise wider awareness of the global warming issue?
solution:
The correct answer is __**James Hansen**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **James Hansen** is best known for his** testimony on climate change to congressional committees in the 1980s**.
 
• His testimony helped raise wider awareness of the global warming issue.
 
• Hansen's work has been crucial in understanding the impact of human activities on the climate.
 
• He emphasized the importance of reducing greenhouse gas emissions to mitigate the effects of climate change.
 
• Hansen's efforts have influenced both public policy and scientific research on climate change.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **James Hansen** is a climate scientist who served as the **director of the NASA Goddard Institute for Space Studies**.
 
• He has published numerous studies on climate change, focusing on the role of carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases.
 
• In his 1988 testimony, Hansen stated that **he was 99% certain that global warming was happening and that it was caused by human activities**.
 
• Hansen has been an advocate for taking immediate action to address climate change, including the implementation of policies to reduce carbon emissions.
 
• His work has earned him numerous awards and recognition in the field of climate science.
